text:
Marco Diaz: Heads-up — partner tech readout run-through tomorrow 10:00 PDT on the demo stage. Need final AV + kit checklist and speaker order. Who can confirm slides and the physical kit pickup?
Alice Nguyen: I can confirm slides. Final deck link: https://redwood.app/slides/partner-readout-v3 (updated speaker notes) :white_check_mark:
Priya Kapoor: I'll own the demo kit pickup from the partner booth at 8:30am. Need list of hardware in the crate.
Connor Lee: I'll be onsite as tech lead. AV requirements: 1x HDMI input, 1x aux for audio, ethernet + power strip. Can we get a lavalier mic for each speaker?
Marco Diaz: Good — add lavs. Speaker order: 10:05 Priya (integration overview), 10:12 Connor (live inferencing demo), 10:20 Marco (cost/scale + closing). Please keep demos within 6–7 minutes.
Evelyn Ramos: Swag status: boxes ready. Samir is routing them to the green room. Qty: 150 shirts, 200 stickers, 50 dongles. Any items we must embargo until partner announcement?
Samir Patel: Logistics note — partner asked to hold any co-branded shirts until the joint blog goes live (ETA: next week). We'll still distribute generic Redwood shirts. Tracking: UPS 1Z999AA10123456784 (arrives 9:45am).
Priya Kapoor: Kit inventory (short):
```
- 1x M.2 GPU dev box
- 1x USB-A ethernet dongle
- 1x 1m HDMI cable
- 2x power strips
- 1x NVMe SSD with image
- 1x backup laptop (MacBook Air)
- misc adapters + dongles
```
Connor Lee: For the demo image, use container tag redwood/partner-demo:2026-03-20. I pushed a tiny patch to reduce cold-start time. Test with --seq-len 512.
Marco Diaz: @Alice can you run the slide deck in presenter mode and verify notes? Also confirm the KMS note on slide 6 is partner-approved.
Alice Nguyen: Will verify. If partner flags slide 6, I'll flip to backup slide that mentions generic 'secure key management' language.
LogisticsBot: Reminder: AV check scheduled at 9:15am at Demo Stage A. Please be present.
Connor Lee: Can someone bring a USB-C to HDMI adapter? I have one but prefer a spare.
Priya Kapoor: I will pack two spares in the kit.
Marco Diaz: Perfect. Last ask — who will monitor the live chat and collect Qs for the panel?
Evelyn Ramos: I'll triage chat with Samir. We'll forward top questions to Priya for the live Q&A. :thumbsup:
Marco Diaz: Thanks all — see you tomorrow. Quick checklist for morning: 8:30 kit pickup, 9:15 AV check, 9:45 swag drop, 10:00 run-through start.
DemoBot: Calendar event created: "Partner tech readout — run-through" 2026-03-21 10:00 PDT. Invitees: Marco, Alice, Priya, Connor, Evelyn, Samir.
